title.description: Short stable title — reuse the exact same title if re-raising an unresolved finding.

detail.description: What is wrong, quoting the exact passage from the draft.

questions_for_human.description: Plain-English questions only the goal owner can answer. Empty when none.

claim_assessments.description: Exactly one assessment for every source marker in the supplied claim ledger. Empty when the draft has no cited claims.

evidence.description: A concise supporting or contradicting passage, or the reason the source could not be checked.

coverage_assessments.description: Exactly one assessment for every deterministically extracted acceptance criterion. Empty only when no contract criteria were supplied.

evidence.description: A concise passage or observation proving the criterion met/unmet, or the reason it remains unclear.
